plan.title: feat(costs): deliberate token/cost capture for non-claude-code harnesses — ohmypi and codex as first-class metering citizens
plan.author: agent:claude-fable-5

narratives.Problem: Cost capture was built around Claude Code JSONL; the other two shipped harnesses were never deliberately wired in. Verified against code and the live DB: (1) the codex reconcile sweep has NO caller — the only route call is reconcile() with no source, a no-op, so ZERO codex cost events exist despite rollout files on disk under agents/*/codex-home/sessions; (2) ohmypi reconcile is gated on a currently-running ohmypi agent, so sessions from exited agents are never swept — ZERO ohmypi events exist; (3) the codex branch records one session-level event deduped by sourceFile, so a growing rollout would freeze at first-import totals; (4) codex-parser.ts:122 hardcodes a 'gpt-5.5' model fallback; (5) unparseable sessions are skipped silently. The PAN-2387 'gpt-5.4-mini $0' drill rows are 4 memory-extraction events — the codex spend is absent, not misparsed. Full evidence in .pan/drafts/pan-2388.md.
narratives.Proposal: Make codex mirror the proven ohmypi shape: a per-turn parseCodexSessionCostEventsSync emitting events from token_count records (model from the latest turn_context, requestId codex:<threadId>:<seq>) so re-sweeps of growing files import only new turns. Wire invocation: a cloister codex-cost-reconciler tick for running codex agents, and make POST /api/costs/reconcile sweep both ohmypi and codex unconditionally as the catch-up path. Remove the hardcoded model fallback; surface unparseable/unknown sessions loudly (skipped[{file,reason}] + console.warn with path). Validate all three parsers with sanitized fixtures harvested from real session files, and prove the end-to-end path by reconciling the existing PAN-2383 slot codex sessions into a visible non-zero drill line.
narratives.NonGoals:
- PAN-2387 item 1: regrouping/renaming the UNKNOWN issue bucket
- PAN-2387 item 2: fixing the issue-level rollup vs per-model row aggregation mismatch
- Fixing memory-extraction $0 pricing (gpt-5.4-mini background events)
- Spend-report backfill tooling (separate issue; shares parsers)
- Changes to the classic pi-parser.ts (legacy; ohmypi-parser.ts is the shipped path)
- Dashboard UI changes
- Launching a new live tiered run as a merge gate (existing on-disk sessions satisfy the live check, per D5)

autoDecisions.summary: Codex metering emits per-turn events with stable requestIds (codex:<threadId>:<seq>) instead of one session-level event
autoDecisions.rationale: Session-level events deduped by sourceFile freeze growing rollouts at first import; per-turn events mirror the working ohmypi design, keep the archive append-only, and attribute per-turn model switches correctly.

autoDecisions.summary: Keep session-level parseCodexSessionSync for its existing consumers (runtimes/codex.ts, codex-conversation-parser.ts)
autoDecisions.rationale: Those callers need a session summary, not cost events; removing it would be an unrelated refactor (Karpathy surgical-changes rule).

autoDecisions.summary: POST /api/costs/reconcile sweeps ohmypi + codex unconditionally; the cloister tick stays gated on running agents
autoDecisions.rationale: The route is the catch-up path for sessions from exited agents; the gated tick keeps the periodic path cheap.

autoDecisions.summary: Remove the hardcoded 'gpt-5.5' fallback; unknown model surfaces loudly
autoDecisions.rationale: Repo rule: never hardcode a model fallback — silent mispricing is worse than a loud unknown.

autoDecisions.summary: Fixtures harvested from real on-disk sessions and sanitized; synthetic only where a provider has no real session, marked as such
autoDecisions.rationale: Acceptance explicitly asks for fixture-backed suites from real session files; sanitization prevents committing user content.

autoDecisions.summary: Live-run acceptance satisfied against existing agent-pan-2383-slot-* codex sessions via the reconcile route + by-issue API
autoDecisions.rationale: The evidence requirement is 'every tier shows correct model + non-zero cost'; existing real sessions prove this without the cost and flake of launching a new tiered run.

autoDecisions.summary: ohmypi cost trust order: inline usage.cost.total, else recompute from pricing table, else loud skip
autoDecisions.rationale: omp's inline cost is authoritative when present (existing parser comment); recomputation covers providers omp doesn't price; silence is banned by acceptance.

narrative.Action: In src/lib/cost-parsers/codex-parser.ts add parseCodexSessionCostEventsSync(sessionFile): CodexCostEventUsage[] mirroring OhmypiCostEventUsage (src/lib/cost-parsers/ohmypi-parser.ts:67 — fields requestId, timestamp, sessionId, sessionFile, provider, model, input, output, cacheRead, cacheWrite, cost). Emit one event per token_count record: model = the most recent turn_context (or task_started) model seen before that record, or 'unknown' if none; requestId = `codex:<threadId>:<seq>` where seq is the 0-based index of the token_count record in the file; provider = 'openai'; tokens from last_token_usage (input_tokens minus cached_input_tokens charged at inputPer1k, cached_input_tokens at cacheReadPer1k, output_tokens at outputPer1k via getPricingSync('openai', model)). IMPLEMENTATION CHECKPOINT (decision D1/H1 in continue.json): before writing the emitter, inspect a real multi-turn rollout from ~/.codex/sessions and confirm last_token_usage values sum to total_token_usage; if they do NOT, emit cumulative-delta events instead (current total_token_usage minus the sum of previously emitted events for the file), same requestId scheme — record which branch was taken in a code comment citing the inspected file. Add tests: the multi-turn fixture yields one event per token_count with distinct requestIds; the events' token sums equal the session-level totals; truncating the fixture to its first N lines and re-parsing yields a strict prefix of the full event list (proves grow-and-resweep imports only new turns).

expected_outputs: integration test passes: reconcile over a temp agents dir with a real-derived codex fixture produces by-issue rows with the real model and non-zero cost

narrative.Action: Two parts. (1) Integration test: build a temp OVERDECK_HOME with agents/agent-pan-9999-slot-1/codex-home/sessions/<date>/rollout.jsonl (the real-derived multi-turn fixture) and agents/agent-pan-9999/sessions/<omp fixture>, run reconcile({source:'codex'}) and reconcile({source:'ohmypi'}) through CostWriter with a temp DB, then read back through the cost resolver (by-issue path) and assert issue pan-9999 shows both harness tiers with their real model ids and cost > 0. (2) Manual verification runbook: document (in the PR description or docs/ as fits existing convention) the operator steps — POST /api/costs/reconcile on the live server, then GET /api/costs/issue/PAN-2383 — and perform them once against the live server AFTER the dashboard is rebuilt and restarted through the normal deploy flow (do NOT hot-patch the live server; note the no-live-boot-hotpatch rule — if a live restart is not appropriate during this issue, record the runbook and mark the live check as operator-deferred in the PR description). The merged test suite is the merge gate; the live check is evidence, not a blocking gate.
